content: ह {%ind.%} An emphatic particle used to lay stress on the preceding word and translatable by ‘verily’, ‘indeed’, ‘certainly’, <ab>&c.</ab>; but it is often used expletively without any particular signification, especially in Vedic literature; तस्य ह शतं जाया बभूवुः; तस्य ह पर्वतनारदौ गृह ऊषतुः <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Ait. Br.</ls>; द्वया ह प्राजापत्या देवाश्चासुराश्च <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 3. 1</ls>. It is sometimes used as a vocative particle and rarely of disdain or laughter. .{@-हः@} .²1 A form of Śiva. .²2 Water. .²3 Sky. .²4 Blood. .²5 A cipher. .²6 Meditation. .²7 Auspiciousness. .²8 Paradise. .²9 Heaven. .²10 Drying. .²11 Fear. .²12 Knowledge. .²13 The moon. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²15 War, battle. .²16 A horse. .²17 Pride. .²18 Horripilation. .²19 A physician. .²20 Cause, motive. .{@-हम्@} .²1 The Supreme Spirit. .²2 Pleasure, delight. .²3 A weapon. .²4 The sparkling of a gem. .²5 The sound of a lute. ({%m.%} also according to some in these senses.)
